QUICK READ / CHOOSING A DESIGN PARTNER

What should i consider when hiring an office interior designer in Gurugram.

Compare the process as carefully as the proposal.

Three ideas to take into your workplace conversation.

01 / 03

Bring the same brief to each conversation

Share the measured area, building condition, intended occupancy, budget assumptions and desired scope. Different inputs make proposals difficult to compare.

Next idea ↓
02 / 03

Ask for relevant evidence

Discuss directly relevant project examples, the people involved and the proposed deliverables. Confirm who will be responsible for design, pricing, site coordination and changes.

Next idea ↓
03 / 03

Make the commercial assumptions visible

Ask about inclusions, exclusions, review stages and how changes are agreed. A well-presented image should sit alongside a clear description of what will actually be provided.

Put it in your brief ↗
A PRACTICAL TAKEAWAY

Before you decide.

  • Compare equivalent scopes and deliverables.
  • Verify references directly where appropriate.
  • Confirm responsibilities and change procedures before appointing anyone.
